beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Paul gave the early church a short, sharp command about what to believe and what to keep.

timing.text: Paul gave the early church a short, sharp command about what to believe and what to keep.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

timing.text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Test everything, he said. Don't swallow every voice — weigh it, hold it up to the light.

timing.text: Don't swallow every voice — weigh it, hold it up to the light.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And notice what he had just said one breath earlier: despise not prophesyings. The testing was never for shutting God's voice out — it is how you recognize it.

timing.text: And notice what he had just said one breath earlier: despise not prophesyings.
The testing was never for shutting God's voice out — it is how you recognize it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And when you find what is genuinely good, cling to it. Don't let it slip.

timing.text: And when you find what is genuinely good, cling to it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He paired it with a warning — and it's the shortest fence he ever built:

timing.text: He paired it with a warning — and it's the shortest fence he ever built:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

timing.text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same word fits now: a faith that checks, then commits — that's steady, not gullible.

timing.text: The same word fits now: a faith that checks, then commits — that's steady, not gullible.

card.text: Weigh it, then hold it. The good He shows you is worth keeping — reach for it.
